blocks.goal: Preserve Navigator as a small compatibility facade while keeping node-related lookup behavior in NavigatorNodeLookup.

ops.details: Keep Navigator as the public compatibility facade and ensure the listed node-oriented methods contain no lookup implementation beyond delegation to NavigatorNodeLookup. Do not duplicate traversal or search logic in Navigator.

blocks.goal: Preserve Navigator as a small compatibility facade while keeping declaration-related lookup behavior in NavigatorDeclarationLookup.

ops.details: Keep the deprecated declaration lookup methods as compatibility entry points, but ensure their implementation is limited to delegation to NavigatorDeclarationLookup. Retain the existing deprecation documentation and signatures.

blocks.goal: Preserve Navigator as a small compatibility facade while keeping type lookup behavior in NavigatorTypeLookup.

ops.details: Keep both findType overloads and the type-demand methods as compatibility entry points, with Navigator delegating all type resolution to NavigatorTypeLookup. Retain the existing method documentation and signatures.

blocks.goal: Reduce the implementation responsibility of Navigator without breaking its existing public API.

ops.details: Keep only imports required by Navigator's public method signatures and delegation statements. Remove imports that are no longer needed after confirming all lookup implementations remain in the specialized lookup classes.
